title: Core: drag-to-place library item on stage
description: Implement a pure function for placing a library item onto a frame: placeLibraryItem(doc, sceneIdx, layerIdx, frameIdx, libraryItemId, x, y): FlashDocument. For Symbol items: creates a SymbolInstance at (x,y). For BitmapItem: creates a BitmapDisplayObject (if that type exists) or a shape with the bitmap fill. Returns new FlashDocument. Check packages/core/src/engine/types.ts for BitmapDisplayObject. Add it if missing. Add unit tests in packages/core/src/engine/__tests__/library-place.test.ts.
